Monologue: And so your tale comes to an end. You are fated to wander the ruins of Verehn, once a glorious culinary capital, now sick with ghosts like you.
The decay will persist. After all, rot is kinder than starvation. The most desperately sick thing about mankind is their want.
Wanting to live, to eat, to love, to laugh—to kill, to ravage, to pillage, and destroy.
Do what you will. Fate has woven her web.
May we meet again some life, when the sunlight once again warms our skin.
